pages.title: Sample diff 1/3: app/auth/oauth_login.py (authorize URL)
pages.content:
diff --git a/app/auth/oauth_login.py b/app/auth/oauth_login.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/app/auth/oauth_login.py
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+# OAuth login scaffold: authorization-code flow with PKCE.
+import hashlib
+import secrets
+from base64 import urlsafe_b64encode
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+
+AUTHORIZE_URL = 'https://id.example.test/oauth/authorize'
+TOKEN_URL = 'https://id.example.test/oauth/token'
+
+
+def new_pkce_pair():
+    # One (verifier, challenge) pair per login attempt.
+    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(48)
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()
+    challenge = urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b'=').decode()
+    return verifier, challenge
+
+
+def build_authorize_url(client_id, redirect_uri, state, challenge):
+    query = urlencode({
+        'response_type': 'code',
+        'client_id': client_id,
+        'redirect_uri': redirect_uri,
+        'state': state,
+        'code_challenge': challenge,
+        'code_challenge_method': 'S256',
+    })
+    return AUTHORIZE_URL + '?' + query

pages.title: Sample diff 2/3: app/auth/oauth_login.py (callback)
pages.content:
@@ -0,0 +28,22 @@ app/auth/oauth_login.py (continued)
+
+
+class OAuthError(Exception):
+    pass
+
+
+def handle_callback(params, expected_state, exchange_code):
+    # Refuse a callback that does not belong to this login attempt.
+    if params.get('error'):
+        raise OAuthError(params['error'])
+    if params.get('state') != expected_state:
+        raise OAuthError('state mismatch')
+    code = params.get('code')
+    if not code:
+        raise OAuthError('missing code')
+    tokens = exchange_code(code)
+    if 'access_token' not in tokens:
+        raise OAuthError('no access token returned')
+    return {
+        'access_token': tokens['access_token'],
+        'expires_in': int(tokens.get('expires_in', 3600)),
+    }

pages.title: Sample diff 3/3: tests/test_oauth_login.py
pages.content:
diff --git a/tests/test_oauth_login.py b/tests/test_oauth_login.py
new file mode 100644
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_oauth_login.py
@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import pytest
+from app.auth import oauth_login as oauth
+
+
+def test_pkce_pair_is_unique():
+    assert oauth.new_pkce_pair() != oauth.new_pkce_pair()
+
+
+def test_authorize_url_carries_state_and_challenge():
+    url = oauth.build_authorize_url('app', 'https://app.example.test/cb', 's1', 'ch')
+    assert 'state=s1' in url and 'code_challenge=ch' in url
+
+
+def test_callback_rejects_state_mismatch():
+    with pytest.raises(oauth.OAuthError):
+        oauth.handle_callback({'state': 'other', 'code': 'c'}, 's1', dict)
+
+
+def test_callback_rejects_missing_code():
+    with pytest.raises(oauth.OAuthError):
+        oauth.handle_callback({'state': 's1'}, 's1', dict)
+
+
+def test_callback_returns_access_token():
+    exchange = lambda code: {'access_token': 'tok-' + code}
+    result = oauth.handle_callback({'state': 's1', 'code': 'c'}, 's1', exchange)
+    assert result['access_token'] == 'tok-c'
+    assert result['expires_in'] == 3600
